flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi OwnerDriverControllerPlus (plus-offence-notice-owner-driver, plus-update-offence-notice-owner-driver: inbound from PLUS), application-prod.properties ocms.plus.key.validation. No outbound client to PLUS, receiver of appeal data, or appeal address storage in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui
note: Story status: No requirement (requirement not given), traced normally from the story text. The story asks OCMS to send the ID to PLUS and then receive appeal details and the appeal address for a specified period. Every PLUS integration in the code is inbound: PLUS calls plus-* endpoints in ocmsadminapi, including reading owner-driver by idNo (OwnerDriverControllerPlus.java:27) and updating it (:39). There is no outbound call to PLUS, no receiver/storage for appeal data, no period parameter, and no logic for an alternative address from appeals. PLUS-side behaviour cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Not claimed: no requirement was given and there is no code to send an ID to PLUS or receive appeal data. The existing PLUS integration runs in the opposite direction

steps.step: OCMS sends the offender's ID number to PLUS
steps.detail: There is no outbound client/URL to PLUS in the six repos (grep for plus in properties and Java: only the APIM header name and inbound plus-* endpoints), no 'X months' setting, and no appeal table/endpoint in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi. The plus-offence-notice-owner-driver endpoint receives an idNo from PLUS (OwnerDriverControllerPlus.java:27), so PLUS queries OCMS, not OCMS sending the ID to PLUS. The ocms.plus.key.validation property (application-prod.properties:60) only validates the key on inbound calls.

steps.step: OCMS receives details of appeals from the ID during a specified period
steps.detail: There is no appeal endpoint, DTO, entity or table in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi/thirdpartyapi, and no period parameter. plus-update-offence-notice-owner-driver (OwnerDriverControllerPlus.java:39) only accepts owner/driver field changes from PLUS, not a list of appeals per ID and period.

steps.step: The appeal details include the address and OCMS identifies whether there is an alternative address from the appeal
steps.detail: There is no address-from-appeal field. The only alternative address lookup (findAlternativeAddress, DataHiveUenFinService.java:3564-3600) uses lta_reg/furnished_mail addresses already in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver_addr, not an address from an appeal, so it is not counted.
